title: Mace Limiter & Ritual
description: This Plugin add a Mace Ritual and Limit System in Your Server.
body:
🧙 RitualMace | Powerful Ritual-Based Mace Plugin
Bring epic server-wide events to your Minecraft SMP with RitualMace — a unique plugin where players must complete dangerous rituals to obtain rare, powerful maces.

🔮 ✨ Features
⚔️ Ritual System
Start a global ritual event
Ritual lasts 10 minutes
Visible to all players
Creates intense PvP moments around the ritual location.

📊 Bossbar Display
Shows:
📍 Ritual Coordinates
⏳ Remaining Time
Fully immersive experience for all players.

🔥 Limited Mace System
Maximum 3 maces per server (Customizeable in Config)
Prevents overpowered item abuse
Keeps gameplay balanced for SMPs

⚔️ Custom Ritual Mace
Unique named weapon: ⚔ Ritual Mace ⚔
Includes custom lore
Designed as a rare end-game item

🔒 Soulbound System
Mace is:
❌ Not droppable
❌ Cannot be stored in chests
✔ Bound to the player

📢 Server Announcements
Ritual start broadcast
10-second warning before completion
Final completion announcement with location

🛠️ Admin Commands
Bash
Copy code
/ritualmace reload
/ritualmace status
/ritualmace reset
/ritualmace setcount <amount>
Permission:
ritualmace.admin

🎮 Perfect For
Lifesteal SMP
PvP Servers
Hardcore SMP
Event-based gameplay servers

⚙️ Configuration
Easy-to-edit config file:
Change ritual duration
Customize bossbar
Edit messages
Adjust mace limits

📦 Compatibility
✔ Spigot 1.21+
✔ Paper 1.21+

💡 Why Use RitualMace?
Instead of boring crafting, your players must: 👉 Fight
👉 Survive
👉 Control the ritual area
Only then can they claim the ultimate weapon.

🚀 Future Updates (Planned)
Multiple mace types (Void, Wind, Detonate)
Custom abilities (right-click powers)
Particle & sound effects
Data saving improvements

📥 Installation
Download the plugin
Place in /plugins folder
Restart server
Done ✅

⚠️ Note
Only one ritual can run at a time
Designed for competitive gameplay

❤️ Support
If you enjoy the plugin, consider leaving a ⭐ review!
